current_suggestion.pitch: Your list has long-form interviews but no channel that tests what new AI models can and can't do. AI Explained is a solo channel that reads the papers and system cards and runs its own tests. It reports where models fail (reasoning, hallucination, real-world tasks) as well as where they've improved, which fits your interest in honest takes on capability over hype. Videos are about 15-25 minutes, dense but non-technical, and skip the infrastructure and dev-tooling material you want to avoid.
